name: Civil Engineering (International Graduate Program), Ph.D.
department: Graduate School of Engineering — Department of Civil Engineering

app_fee.value: Graduate School of Engineering International Admission Programs examination fee is JPY 10,000 paid online via T-cens / E-shiharai.
app_fee.quote: 10,000 yen is required as the examination fee.

fee_waiver.value: MEXT Embassy-recommended primary selectees and CSC PhD course applicants are exempt from the JPY 10,000 examination fee (University-recommended MEXT awardees are refunded upon enrollment); no general need-based waiver is available.
fee_waiver.quote: *MEXT scholarship candidates who have passed the primary selection at the Japanese embassy in their home countries, and applicants for CSC PhD course are not required to pay this fee.

deadline.value: March 19, 2027 for 2027 Autumn intake (International Graduate Program in Civil Engineering and Infrastructure Studies; opened September 1, 2026 via T-cens).
deadline.quote: Application Period for 2027 Autumn intake：01 September 2026 - 19 March 2027

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for this field (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Department of Civil Engineering international admission page does not state whether pre-application supervisor contact is mandatory prior to registering on T-cens.

funding.value: Department nominates ~30 candidates annually across partner scholarship organizations (MEXT University/Embassy Recommendation, ADB-Japan Scholarship, UEDA Foundation); international track requires a full scholarship (or approved external scholarship such as JICA/LPDP).
funding.quote: The Department of Civil Engineering will nominate qualified candidates and recommend them to partner scholarship organizations, as listed below. Approximately 30 scholarships are disbursed through the following partner organizations every year.

entry_route.value: Doctoral course applicants must have completed (or expect to complete) 18 years of school education with a Master's or equivalent degree.
entry_route.quote: Doctoral course applicants | 5.Those who have completed, or are expected to complete, 18 years of school education by September 30 of the enrolment year, upon completion of their Master's or equivalent degree.*

notes: Students already residing in Japan are ineligible for the International Graduate Program and must apply through Regular Admission. English proficiency is required ('linguistic skills required to take classes and receive research guidance in English'), with no specific TOEFL/IELTS score cutoff stated.
